serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Mrs. Fisher: Woah… What’s happening to you? {{wi}}Scary…
You: That’s my line!
Mrs. Fisher: That never happened before. Did you take any weird drugs that could cause it?
You: Obviously it’s the fault of the fish joint!{{punch}}
Mrs. Fisher: No way…{{wi}} Maybe we should stop?
You: You are asking me?!
You: Besides, how can I stop after all of this? I still feel like I’m getting better!
Mrs. Fisher: As I said, you can get better with hard work. This is not necessary. 
Mrs. Fisher: Listen, I was wrong to propose it to you. It clearly isn’t suitable for you. Who knows what could happen next.
You: But look! I already got better! See?
Mrs. Fisher: Right…
Mrs. Fisher: Just think this through, ok?
You: I will…
